welcome: Hello! I am your farming assistant. How can I help you today?
chatMicHint: Tap the microphone button to ask your question
disclaimerText: AI-generated content. Please verify locally if required.

questions.text: What is the government fertiliser subsidy programme and how do I register?
Tell me about KIAMIS and how to register my farm on it
I want to know about the Kenya Agricultural Insurance Programme
What are the benefits of having my soil tested by KALRO?
Can you explain what farming information NAFIS provides?
What government support programmes are available for farmers?
I need information about KEPHIS certified seed
Tell me about the Agricultural Finance Corporation
How can I get a soil test done for my farm?
What does my soil test report mean?
Which crops are suitable for my soil based on my soil test results?
Can I get a loan if my last harvest failed and I couldn't repay?
Will defaulting on a loan affect my eligibility for government programmes?
What documents do I need to apply for an AFC Kilimo Biashara loan?
How much insurance cover will I get for my maize crop in Trans Nzoia?
What is today's market price for [crop] in [county]?
What are the latest rates for [crop] at [county] market?
What is the current market price of [crop] in [county]?
What is today's weather forecast for [county]?
Will it rain this week in [county]?

capabilities: Answers are based only on standard university documents and crop SOPs.
You can ask about crop practices, pest/disease control, fertilizer schedules, and harvesting methods.
The system can give general agricultural advice but not personalized responses.
limitations: Answers are based on documented best practices—not real-time weather, soil, or market data.
Region-specific and farm-specific recommendations are not available at this time.
Refer to the official SOP documents listed in the app for source references.
